svg.title: MatzHub system architecture diagram
svg.desc: Flow from suppliers posting on WhatsApp, through a persistent worker and a seven-step ingestion pipeline, into Supabase storage, served by a Next.js application on Vercel with external services for AI, payments, notifications and monitoring.
svg.text: From WhatsApp to Your Website — Seamlessly
• Product Detail — images, cart, WhatsApp checkout
Technologies: Next.js (App Router) · PostgreSQL (pg_trgm) · Tailwind CSS
DNS, TLS, optional tunnel · basic WAF
MatzHub | Smart Automation · Scalable Growth · 100% Free Tier
